name: Tracker staging eval set
description: Verifies that a tracker update request searches for and stages new job application entries without committing the write, preserving the confirm-before-write guarantee. This case asserts response content only (final_response_match_v2), not trajectory: root_agent paraphrases the user's request when delegating to tracker_agent (e.g. 'INTENT 2: Stage a write to the job application tracker with application emails from June and July 2026' instead of the verbatim request), so an exact tool-trajectory match on the args passed to tracker_agent cannot reliably pass regardless of correctness. The staged-not-written assertion therefore rests entirely on the judged final response stating that entries were found and staged but not yet written.

parts.text: update my job application tracker with application emails from june and july 2026
I found new job application entries and staged them. Nothing has been written to the sheet yet — would you like me to write them?
